First build committed at 729260008 on branch claude/review-workbench (persisted to primary; not on main).
tools/review_workbench: synth.py (synthetic specimen in the real input schemas, generated test film),
packet.py (pinned inputs; text-free index vs text stores), candidates.py (nomination x3 conventions,
name tokens, BM25, dialogue echo; moments never persons), store.py (append-only JSONL, source-first
gate complete-all, calibration first 5 + every 10th with blind commit/reveal/revision rate, export to
Codex template columns; referent withheld until #136 encoding), server.py (127.0.0.1 + Host check,
single-use token -> HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie, Origin check, no request log, handle_error prints
type only, POST-only text, no-store, CSP), static UI (source pass, recall pass, structure drawer).
Evidence: python3 -m unittest test_workbench: Ran 29 tests, OK. SD1: 10 mutants (host, single-use
token, silent log, no-store, origin, source gate, mention completeness, calibration reveal, referent
withheld, echo function-word rule) each KILLED by its named test, with no other test failing.
UI capture: 10 synthetic specimens, 0 page errors / failed requests / overflow.
Open: W3 referent encoding (Fray #136/#140); gate per-block mode not implemented (complete-all only);
independent code review of the server/store pending; W4h hill climb in progress (v0 critics running).
